_comment: Domains whose links belong in a desktop app rather than a browser window. Adding an app is one object: the bundle id macOS launches, and the hosts it claims. Hosts match themselves and any subdomain, so 'slack.com' covers 'acme.slack.com'. List the host the shared links actually use, not the vendor's whole domain: a host the app does not claim is handed over and silently ignored. Leave Google's own domains out: a Drive or Docs link has to keep the account's browser profile, which is the whole point of the profile setting.
